source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify Server Management BIOS defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without losing BMC/OOB reachability, changing unintended management transports or policies, breaking host/BMC coordination, altering recovery behavior or degrading platform health.
original_method: Manually load defaults, compare named Server Mgmt fields with the exact platform SPEC, apply a bounded field/transport/policy matrix, save/reboot, verify persistence and correlate BIOS values with BMC configuration, reachability, audit, SEL and host health.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret, operate and visually accept Server Mgmt BIOS fields. Automated BMC/API reachability and health checks only corroborate the manual firmware acceptance.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and Server Mgmt page schema
Named fields mapped to BMC access, KCS/BT/SSIF/host interface, network, console, logging, watchdog and recovery behavior
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Management network/session baseline and credential-safe evidence plan
Independent local console and recovery path that survives the tested setting
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or change unspecified management addresses, transports, access, watchdog or recovery policies.
Keep an independent local console/recovery path; do not rely solely on the interface under test.
Never collect credentials, session tokens or private management secrets in evidence.
Archive BMC configuration/audit/SEL and active-session state before changes; avoid clearing forensic evidence.
Stop on OOB loss, host-interface failure, unexpected reset/watchdog, boot degradation or security-policy change.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC identity/configuration where authorized and secret-safe, reachability, host-interface visibility, audit/SEL, boot/OS health and timing around operator phases.
Compare approved expected deltas without editing BMC or BIOS configuration.
Do not drive BIOS, change network/access/watchdog policy, disclose credentials or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve fields, security/access effects, values, sessions, reset behavior and independent recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret management, audit and host-health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; changing the BMC through Redfish/IPMI/WebUI is a different control path and is not an equivalent substitute.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS method and add version-recorded, credential-safe read-only BMC configuration, reachability, host-interface, audit and health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS field to BMC service/transport, security/access effect, host interface, watchdog/logging behavior and independent recovery path; execute one bounded change and verify the exact causal delta.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC pair, management network and host-interface implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, Redfish/IPMI schema/tool, OS/kernel and host-interface driver versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Server Mgmt BIOS field documentation and vendor BMC interface/security guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces page-wide random changes with path-specific management and security validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds transport, access, audit, host-interface and recovery coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/path map, values, credentials policy, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only BMC API state may not expose BIOS-only pending values or activation timing; firmware captures remain required.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected management fields and transports. Results must identify excluded access paths, watchdog/logging behaviors and recovery routes and cannot claim the entire Server Mgmt page.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, field/default/management-path matrix, secret-safe approval and recovery
Baseline BMC configuration/reachability, host interfaces, audit/SEL and host health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and management-state comparison
Per-field non-default captures, persistence and expected path/security deltas
Approved final state, preserved logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. The broad page requires project-specific fields and paths, but no explicit source contradiction exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Server Mgmt configuration intent is clear. Missing field/security/recovery inputs gate execution but do not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds management-path, security and independent-recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its management/boot evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BIOS acceptance from BMC API telemetry and rejects cross-control-path substitution.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted BIOS value from being accepted when the tested transport, host interface, audit trail or independent recovery path has been lost or weakened.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance requires interactive BIOS configuration and visual verification. BMC/API checks cannot perform that manual firmware work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat Server Mgmt changes, reboots or recovery after access, transport, watchdog, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
